title: Supersonic airliner in doubt as company shifts to powering AI data centers
gist: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby says Boom Supersonic's Overture won't be delivered in 2029 as planned, after earlier giving it 50-50 odds of entering service. Boom is pivoting toward AI data center power with a new Colorado factory for its 42 MW Superpower natural gas turbine, but it lost a $1.25B, 29-turbine Crusoe deal. Its North Carolina airliner factory has mostly sat dormant.
